text:
ops-coordinator: Heads up — we need to schedule the PIR for the 1728 paging incident. Thinking Friday morning PT. Prefer a staggered slot so CS can do a customer readout + infra deep-dive. Who can facilitate?

maria: I can facilitate but prefer 09:30 PT so I can finish the timeline doc. 09:30-10:15 OK?

ashwin: I can attend and volunteer logs + RCA help, but not facilitator.

lex: I can shadow and act as backup facilitator. I can also take notes if needed.

oncall-bot: Incident 1728 summary: 2025-11-03 02:22 UTC — multi-tenant evictions due to kernel OOM after driver update. Impact: ~12% request error rate for 20m, degraded tail latency. Pager run: page->mitigate->rollback. Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1728

ops-coordinator: Thanks. Need someone for the customer readout (CS) and someone to own the action tracker during the PIR.

tia: I can do the customer readout (CS). I have the transcript and CS notes ready.

sam: I can own the actions tracker and follow up items. I'll prepare the template.

elena: CS can attend and support the readout at 09:00, but 09:30 is fine too. We'll prepare impact numbers and customer list.

jeff: Can we make it 45m instead of 1h? Calendar is tight. 09:30-10:15 is 45m — works for me.

maria: 45m is fine. Please add the pre-read link in the invite: https://rwd.internal/pir/1728/pre-read

ops-coordinator: Plan: Maria facilitator, Lex backup/shadow, Tia customer readout, Sam actions owner, Ashwin brings infra logs. I'll book 09:30 PT for 45m and send invites + pre-read. Agenda: 1) timeline (10m) 2) root cause analysis (15m) 3) customer impact (10m) 4) actions + owners (10m).

ashwin: I'll drop the relevant log extraction command here for the session: ```gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.project_id="redwood" AND jsonPayload.incident=1728' --limit 50 --project=prod-us-west1```

ops-coordinator: Great — I'll ping SRE leads and CS. If Maria needs to drop, Lex you're first backup. :thumbsup:

maria: All set from my side. I'll upload the timeline slides to the doc and tag folks. Thanks everyone.

ops-coordinator: Invite sent. Channel for notes: #incidents/doc-1728. If anyone needs a different timezone slot, tell me now and I'll try to accommodate.
